item.title: PHP security flaws trigger global scramble; CERT-In flags vulnerabilities
item.description: Google Cloud executives Chris Betz, chief information security officer, and Raluca Ada Popa, head of Gemini Security at Google DeepMind, said PHP and cybersecurity firm Wiz Research disclosed the two vulnerabilities after research that used multiple AI models to identify and help remediate them. Google Cloud said its own infrastructure was not vulnerable, but warned that customers running PHP applications on the platform could be exposed
item.dc:creator: SHILPA PHADNIS

item.title: Hospitals ‘overcharging’ is a malpractice: Govt to Supreme Court
item.description: In an affidavit filed in SC on the issue of capping prices of all medicines and medical consumables, chemicals and fertilisers ministry said that patients have a very low bargaining position with respect to hospitals, resulting in various malpractices. The affidavit noted the irony of India being home to companies making cheap drugs but patients here having to pay way above the manufacturing price, as well as patients being subjected to overcharging by hospitals.
item.dc:creator: AMIT ANAND CHOUDHARY

item.title: 16 killed, 32 injured in magnitude 7 earthquake in Tibet; rescue ops under way
item.description: Police and fire department personnel have been working to rescue people and provide temporary shelter to those who had lost their homes. Rescue teams were also putting up tents to accommodate residents displaced by the earthquake. According to the United States Geological Survey (USGS), the earthquake occurred at 10.33 pm local time.
item.dc:creator: RAJEEV SINGH

item.title: Centre betrayed us, now want full statehood for Ladakh: Sonam Wangchuk
item.description: Wangchuk said the representatives of Leh Apex Body (LAB) and Kargil Democratic Alliance (KDA) had come prepared for Oct 22 talks in Delhi as a follow up of the May 15 meeting in Leh, with the expectation that the MHA and Ladakh bodies' respective drafts on contours and powers of UT-level body and district councils, would be discussed.
item.dc:creator: BHARTI JAIN AND NASEER GANAI

item.title: Will back all meaningful efforts for Ukraine peace, PM Modi assures Poland's Tusk
item.description: PM Modi and his Polish counterpart Tusk expressed deepest concern in a joint statement over the war in Ukraine, including its tragic humanitarian consequences and the impact on Global South. In his media statement, Modi assured Tusk that whether it is Ukraine or West Asia, India will continue to support every meaningful effort for peace.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: After renaming Lake Ontario, Google CEO rejects US request to rename Atlantic Ocean
item.description: President Trump has recently proposed renaming the Atlantic Ocean, following prior discussions about the Atlantic Ocean. During a recent event, he mentioned contacting Google Maps regarding these renaming efforts. Google CEO Sundar Pichai reportedly declined his proposal on the grounds that oceans encompass multiple countries. This follows the US administration's earlier renaming of Lake Ontario to Lake America for US users.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Florida couple missed 66 mortgage payments; man's bank lawsuit rejected
item.description: A Florida couple missed 66 monthly mortgage payments on their Naples property, triggering a foreclosure dispute that began in 2009. During the legal battle, Gregory Brian Myers agreed to deposit $5,000 monthly while appealing the foreclosure. He later sued U.S. Bank, alleging it had violated their agreement. On October 19, 2026, a federal appeals court upheld the dismissal of his lawsuit.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Will decide on any notice to remove CEC according to rules: LS Speaker Om Birla
item.description: Both the Lok Sabha Speaker and the Rajya Sabha chairman had rejected previous notices from the opposition, saying their allegations “do not prima facie meet the high constitutional bar for removal proceedings”. Birla noted the process for removal of the chief election commissioner was the same as for removing a Supreme Court judge.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Movie glorifies violence, generalises graft in medical field: IMA
item.description: In a letter, dated Oct 22, to I&B minister Ashwini Vaishnaw, IMA national president Dr Anilkumar J Nayak sought an impartial review of the promo video for the upcoming film and appropriate corrective measures from its makers. It also called for a ban or other action if justified under applicable law. The letter was also copied to the Union health and home ministries and the chairperson of National Medical Commission.
item.dc:creator: ANUJA JAISWAL

item.title: In call with Bibi, PM Modi says urgent need to restore West Asia peace
item.description: PM Modi said he had received acall from Netanyahu during which the leaders reviewed the sustained momentum in bilateral ties and reaffirmed their commitment to further strengthening the partnership. Modi did not mention Netanyahu’s invitation in his post on the conversation. “We exchanged views on developments in West Asia and underscored the urgent need to restore peace and stability in the region,” Modi said on X.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Necklace almost priced at £15 for car boot sale later sold for £99,000
item.description: Imagine a dusty car boot sale where a unique necklace fashioned from human hair and whale bone was nearly sold for just £15. Fortunately, it caught the eye of an expert at Ewbank's auction house, revealing its immense worth, which fetched an incredible £99,000 at auction. This story underscores the vital role of appraisals in recognizing hidden treasures that often go unnoticed in clearance sales.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: South Carolina home with 3 kitchens and indoor pool lists for $1.227m
item.description: Nestled at 108 Hampton Avenue, this unique property in Goose Creek is now on the market. It boasts three distinct kitchens, creatively themed bedrooms, and a generous indoor pool. Spanning 5,390 square feet, this estate is perfect for multigenerational families or as a lucrative short-term rental option. The outdoor spaces are ideal for entertaining.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: Palantir exec to Europe: You need China for drones and US tech for now
item.description: Palantir Technologies highlights the necessary reliance on US technology for European countries in the short term. Louis Mosley addressed challenges, including Europe’s reliance on China for industrial components needed for defense capabilities. As European nations consider reducing foreign technology use, Palantir faces scrutiny from some countries like France and the UK. Nonetheless, Mosley noted strong engagement in markets like Ukraine, where practical needs take precedence.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Minnesota court reverses $20,000 privacy award in driveway camera feud
item.description: In Minnesota, a conflict brewed between two couples over a shared driveway and the removal of a tree. The Stahleys performed maintenance on the Rubys' land without consent, leading to a legal battle. Ultimately, the court awarded the Rubys $27,000, with $20,000 for invasion of privacy. However, the appeals court overturned the privacy ruling, necessitating further proceedings and adjusting the damages for tree removal.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Resignation by Justice Yashwant Varma may end Lok Sabha proceedings
item.description: Justice Yashwant Varma’s name still figuring on the list of judges on the HC website had bolstered the view. However, sources said legal opinion, backed by a court verdict, that an HC judge’s resignation comes into effect as soon as he resigns may prevail in what was earlier seen as a legal grey area.
item.dc:creator: RAKESH KUMAR

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo reportedly invested $70 million in real estate in 2025
item.description: Since October 2025, NBA superstar Giannis Antetokounmpo has strategically invested approximately $70 million in various real estate ventures. His family's company, Ante, has facilitated several significant purchases, including apartment complexes in Wisconsin, Brooklyn, and Chicago. Notably, he recently acquired a lavish $13.5 million mansion in Pinecrest, Florida, after joining the Miami Heat. These investments reflect Antetokounmpo's commitment to expanding his financial portfolio beyond basketball income.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Murray’s wife Kim Sears, four children: Inside his family life after retirement
item.description: Andy Murray has officially retired from professional tennis and, in doing so, has opened a new chapter in his life, and the former world No 1 will have more time to spend with his wife Kim Sears and their four children. From parenting and family routines to their shared business interests at Cromlix, the couple are handling life outside the demands of professional tennis while keeping family at the center.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Centre flags data gap, regulatory hurdles in curbing hospital mark-ups
item.description: The Union govt has told the SC in its affidavit that margins on hospital consumables can range from 100% to 1,000% or more, highlighting concerns over the high mark-ups patients often face on supplies used during treatment. However, a senior official told TOI that the govt does not have the data needed to assess margins across hospital supplies and determine whether wider controls are warranted.
item.dc:creator: ANUJA JAISWAL

item.title: MEA calls out UN report for saying Dawood Ibrahim's D-company India-based
item.description: First secretary in India’s permanent mission to UN, Raghoo Puri, was responding to a report by Ben Saul, the special rapporteur on the ‘Promotion and Protection of Human Rights and Fundamental Freedoms while Countering Terrorism’. He said this presented member-states with a fait accompli, an unfortunate situation for an organisation already facing challenges to its legitimacy.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: From Jan 1, WhatsApp, Telegram won’t work without SIM cards, govt issues guidelines
item.description: The move is to curb cross-border cyber frauds, phishing, digital arrest scams using Indian mobile numbers and enhance telecom cyber security. Apple has updated iOS with a software patch to help detect when an iPhone is operating without a physical SIM card to abide with the rules. It is learnt Signal has not yet responded to govt notices.
item.dc:creator: SAURABH SINHA

item.title: Govt plans colour-coded driving licence for Indians, foreigners
item.description: Life insurance policies, too, would no longer be accepted as proof. Proposing sweeping changes to the driving licence (DL) regime under Motor Vehicles Rules, the road transport ministry Wednesday issued a draft notification to raise the pass mark for the online safe-driving tutorial assessment from the current 60% to 75%.
item.dc:creator: DIPAK K DASH

item.title: Sonia Gandhi makes Instagram debut, shares first look of her upcoming book
item.description: In her first post on Instagram, Sonia shared a video of her welcoming the first copies of her autobiography “Belonging: A journey of love” which is set to be released on Nov 10. The video showed her holding up the book and then sharing sweets with daughter and MP Priyanka Gandhi Vadra. “It is a story of love, duty, loss and finding a place to belong. I look forward to sharing it with you,” Sonia wrote on the post.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Don’t blindly follow foreign custody order: Supreme Court
item.description: A bench of Justices J B Pardiwala and K V Viswanathan said cases already dealt with by foreign courts were coming before it time and again and their adjudication was not easy as they involved deeply emotional and sensitive issues. It added that the welfare of the child “must be understood in the widest sense, not by money or physical comfort alone”.
item.dc:creator: AMIT ANAND CHOUDHARY

item.title: Indian dies in Saudi airport strike; MEA slams infrastructure attacks
item.description: India has condemned the continued attacks on civilian and energy infrastructure. “These attacks have unfortunately resulted in civilian deaths and injuries. We convey our heartfelt condolences to the bereaved family and wish speedy recovery to those injured. The Indian embassy in Riyadh...will provide all possible assistance,” said ministry of external affairs (MEA) in a statement. The victim has not been identified by Saudi authorities so far.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: 21 years on, double life term for Jammu terror attack that killed baby, 2 others
item.description: In his order on Wednesday, principal sessions judge Ramban Ajay Kumar Gupta rejected defence arguments that the attack had taken place more than two decades ago when Sharief was young, his long incarceration and possibility of rehabilitation. Besides the life sentences, the court imposed two separate terms of 10 years on Sharief under various sections pertaining to murder and arms act offences.
item.dc:creator: SANJAY KHAJURIA

item.title: 3 aircraft carriers, jets & troops: Israel, US plan to attack Iran after midterms
item.description: The United States and Israel are preparing for potential military strikes against Iran after the upcoming midterm elections. Iran has announced it will reveal a new weapon called the 'Father of All Bombs' as tensions rise. US Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth met Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to discuss military options recently. Meanwhile, Iranian officials warn of severe responses if attacked, emphasizing improved missile capabilities.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: CEC impeachment: Birla says fresh motion will be examined as per rules
item.dc:creator: AASHISH SAXENA

item.title: PM Modi calls for stronger global institutions; takes ‘failed product’ jab at Cong
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi emphasized the need for stronger global institutions during his address at the NDTV World Summit. He argued that the current global system struggles to address new challenges, particularly in international relations. Modi also criticized Congress leadership for failing to effectively launch their leader, calling it a burden on the party. Furthermore, he highlighted India's role in international cooperation, especially during the Covid-19 pandemic.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Civil war & terror: Why Libya is still broken 15 yrs after Gaddafi's bloody end
item.description: Since the fall of Muammar Gaddafi in 2011, Libya has been trapped in a cycle of political strife and disunity. Although a UN-backed agreement was reached with hopes of conducting elections, various administrations maintain control over separate regions. By April 2026, a unified national budget was achieved, yet obstacles to effective implementation loom large.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: BrahMos goes global, eyes next-gen missile by 2028; 1,500-km strike variant on radar
item.description: BrahMos Aerospace is set to develop the next-generation BrahMos-NG missile by 2027-28. The company aims to strengthen its supply chain and production capacity to meet increasing demand. Interest from foreign militaries in air-launched versions of BrahMos is growing. A 1,500-km-range variant is also under exploration but remains at a conceptual stage. Recent contracts with the Indian Navy are expected to boost domestic manufacturing and participation from local industries.
item.dc:creator: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA

item.title: Sundar the Sailor: Google nixes Trump’s search to name an ocean after himself
item.dc:creator: CHIDANAND RAJGHATTA

item.title: Iran claims 7 oil tankers damaged in Hormuz, warns strikes if US helps passage
item.description: Seven oil tankers sustained damage in the Strait of Hormuz as a result of attacks and naval mines. Four of the tankers reportedly caught fire while transferring oil, creating significant challenges. Iranian authorities have warned of potential targeting of US bases if the situation escalates.
item.dc:creator: PRANJAL PANDEY

item.title: What El Nino? This ground up farmers’ cooperative continues to reap dividends
item.description: Farmers in Mulkanoor village have established a cooperative that supports agricultural needs, improving self-reliance. This cooperative has recently partnered with HarvestLink to export branded rice to the US market. They expect their first shipment of rice to be dispatched within a month, pending regulations. The cooperative has a strong membership base and provides various support services to its members.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: ‘No permission needed to hoist national flag’: Neha Bora tells Delhi HC
item.dc:creator: AADRITA HALDER

item.title: Michigan court upholds $85,000 and $91,250 awards in neighbours' water feud
item.description: A years-long dispute between neighbours in Michigan over flooding and water flowing across their properties resulted in both sides receiving compensation. A jury awarded $85,000 to William Michael Coan and Cindy Plant and $91,250 to Robert Ercolani. On October 20, 2026, the Michigan Court of Appeals upheld both awards and an independent drainage plan intended to address the flooding.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Georgia woman loses marijuana smoke case as court upholds pension fund immunity
item.description: A Georgia woman sued after claiming her neighbour’s marijuana smoke repeatedly entered her apartment despite a no-smoking lease, affecting her breathing and health. Bridget Francis alleged that the apartment management ignored her complaints. However, on October 19, 2026, a Georgia appeals court upheld the dismissal of her claims against a California teachers’ pension fund, ruling that it was legally protected from the lawsuit.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: 'Against policy': Bikaner House on removal of photos from Raihan Vadra exhibition
item.dc:creator: VIVEK DUBEY

item.title: One frame at a time! Story of Multan's Minhas brothers through their father's lens
item.description: Kashif Minhas once gave up his own cricketing ambitions at his father's insistence. Today, the Multan-based businessman watches his sons Arafat and Sameer represent Pakistan, capturing their journeys through his lens while hoping they will fulfil his dream of winning an ICC trophy for the country.
item.dc:creator: PRATYUSH RAJ

item.title: Bengaluru horror: Man kills wife, steals motorcycle to dump body in drain Do
item.description: Mohammad Irfaj, a 22-year-old migrant labourer from Bihar, allegedly murdered his 25-year-old wife Ruksana over infidelity suspicions. The couple’s relationship had deteriorated, leading to frequent quarrels about her phone conversations. On October 10, Irfaj killed Ruksana with a stone and concealed her body in a stormwater drain. Police discovered her body three days later and identified her after public inquiries.
item.dc:creator: SIDDHI DHARMADHIKARI

item.title: Indian diaspora could pay price for West’s immigration backlash, warns Sushant Sareen
item.description: As Trump blames France’s unrest on immigration and urges Macron to close borders, expert warns law-abiding Indians could get caught in the crossfire
item.dc:creator: ANANYA DASGUPTA

item.title: Connecticut wool mill that lost 85 jobs now employs 50, makes military fabric
item.description: A Connecticut wool mill that closed in 2013, leaving 85 workers jobless, has been revived by former investment banker Jacob Harrison Long. He bought the 475,000-square-foot factory in 2014 despite having no manufacturing experience. Twelve years later, the mill employs about 50 people and supplies fabric for US military uniforms. Long now hopes to expand textile manufacturing across New England.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Newton's 1687 book on gravity, funded by Halley, sold for Rs 5.49 crore
item.description: In a significant auction event, a first edition of Isaac Newton's *Philosophiæ naturalis principia mathematica* garnered an impressive US$576,000. This pivotal work introduced revolutionary concepts of motion and gravity through mathematical frameworks. With ties to distinguished scholars like the Kennet family and the vital endorsement from Edmond Halley, Newton's insights continue to resonate in disciplines such as engineering and astronomy, shaping modern scientific thought.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
